question: Pointing to a girl in a photograph, Amit said, "She is the daughter of the only sister of my father." How is the girl related to Amit?
solution:
Decoding symbols for Family Tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/153c6a6e313de03f2911e6352e768c319ce48bd8d9b10cf6c7d58c07f604979a.png] 

According to the given information Family Tree Representation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4996be56e11dd24cc10ce4fadedffacf1c97650bb2326d5dd46f6674c424b4cf.png] 

"She is the daughter of the only sister of my father."

The "only sister of my father" is Amit's paternal aunt.

The "daughter of the only sister of my father" is the daughter of Amit's aunt.

Thus, the girl is the **Cousin** of Amit.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
